item.description:
• A redesigned action wheel: one smooth glass ring with a soft glow that follows your pointer
  • Each action lights up in its own color and grows slightly as you hover it
  • The menu bar icon always shows, even before Accessibility access is granted
  • The welcome window comes to the front on first launch
  • Copies and clipboard restores made by Typefu stay out of other clipboard apps' history

• Use the selection bar on text you select in Chrome and other Chromium browsers
  • See your license at a glance with a new Licensed view in Settings

• Get suggestions for the next few words in grey as you type, and press Tab to insert them, all run by models on your Mac
  • Shape Autosuggestion with your own instructions
  • Use Autosuggestion in Chromium and Electron apps too
  • Download and manage local models right in AI Providers
  • Choose Parakeet as a dictation model next to Whisper
  • Turn expansion on or off from the menu bar, now with icons on every item
  • Create folders from the sidebar and from the snippet list's New menu
  • Search and filter items in the Menu pane
  • Work in a cleaner editor with a colorful header and actions at the top
  • See a clear explanation when a template needs a change, plus a hint when a snippet name with spaces needs quotes

• Expand abbreviations as you type in any app, or search every snippet from the launcher
  • Add fill-in fields to snippets for names, dates and choices, filled in a small form near the caret
  • Select text to get a bar of actions: search, translate, change case, format, and add to Calendar, Reminders or Contacts
  • Proofread, rewrite, summarize and reply with AI actions that run on your Mac
  • Check grammar and spelling, and apply every suggestion in one click
  • Dictate into Check Grammar, transcribed on your Mac
  • Paste earlier copies from a clipboard history that keeps every item across relaunches
  • Back up your library, actions and settings to a .typefu file and restore it on another Mac
